visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair, wearing a black tank top, performs push-ups using only his index finger on a light-colored wooden floor. The setting is a home office with a cluttered desk, a computer monitor, and white shoes nearby. The lighting is bright and natural from a window. (2) A series of rapid cuts show the man in various heroic and surreal scenarios: posing in front of a digital explosion in a living room, playing with a young child in a colorful indoor ball pit, and fighting a CGI tiger in an outdoor courtyard. He then appears lying on a floor surrounded by beer bottles and two sleeping tigers, and later sitting in a chair while a woman's legs are draped over him and someone pinches his cheek. (3) The man is shown engaging in daily chores and fitness activities: walking on a treadmill, wearing a motorcycle helmet in front of a fire effect, walking a masked child up stairs, and lifting dumbbells in his bedroom. He also interacts with a tabby cat, vacuums a modern white kitchen, and cleans a bed with a handheld vacuum. These scenes are brightly lit and take place in clean, domestic environments. (4) The video transitions to a product demonstration. Close-up shots feature 'GREEN GOLD' and 'SOUL MAN' supplement packaging, showing white and greyish-blue capsules being poured out onto a wooden surface. The man is seen taking a pill and then using a vibration exercise platform. Graphic overlays with various technical texts appear frequently over the man and the products. (5) Artistic and surreal imagery follows: the man stands on a rocky shore as waves crash behind him during a sunset, then he is shown sleeping on a bed completely covered by nearly a dozen cats. He meditates with a swirling galaxy background before the scene shifts back to the man fighting tigers in his bedroom and shadowboxing with a group of people on a street. (6) In the final phase, the man holds up the supplement bags and capsules toward the camera in a brightly lit room. He wears glasses and looks directly at the lens. Large text overlays displaying a discount code and promotional information occupy the bottom half of the screen as the man continues to speak.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features a diverse range of backgrounds including a cluttered home office, a modern kitchen with high-end appliances, an indoor ball pit for children, a suburban street, a grassy park during sunset, and various CGI environments like an explosion site, a galaxy, and a beach with crashing waves.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator begins speaking in a clear, moderate-tempo Mandarin/Taiwanese tone. The background music is an upbeat, pop-electronic hybrid with a steady percussive beat. Subtle impact sound effects sync with the visual finger-pushup action. (2) Vocal intensity remains consistent as the narration discusses masculinity and strength. Sharp whoosh and boom sound effects are layered in as CGI explosions and tiger fights are shown. The music maintains a constant 120 BPM energy. (3) The audio transitions to a more informative tone as the narrator describes the supplement benefits. Sound effects of a vacuum whirring and a cat's soft vocalization are heard briefly. The background music remains upbeat but slightly lowered in the mix. (4) The final phase features the narrator delivering a more persuasive and enthusiastic pitch. Digital notification-style sound effects punctuate the display of the coupon code and discount details. The music swells slightly in volume toward the conclusion of the audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy advertisement for 'GREEN GOLD Soul Man' supplements. It uses a mix of humor, hyperbole (fighting CGI tigers), and relatable domestic struggles to appeal to men in their 40s who may feel a lack of energy for both their fitness goals and family responsibilities.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of product, mention of brand name, discount code, and detailed ingredient list.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes social-media native editing styles with high text density and rapid cuts to maintain engagement. The contrast between surreal CGI scenes and relatable home life creates a comedic but effective narrative for the product.
